Instagram Editor AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launch of cloud-based Instagram video editor for Reels and Stories.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB) with fast 1080p MP4 exports.
- Simple instructions: describe edits you want (crop, captions, duration, etc.) and get a ready-to-upload result in 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic session setup and free token generation for first-time users.
- Easy workflow for uploading, editing, exporting, and checking credits or status, all from chat.
- Seamless batch editing and timeline previews for Instagram creators.
